title: MCP-AQL Specification
description: MCP-AQL is a protocol specification that consolidates Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools into semantic endpoints, providing large token reductions while maintaining full functionality. It defines a unified query language for structured communication between AI models and context-providing services, with five semantic operations (Create, Read, Update, Delete, Execute), runtime introspection, schema-driven dispatch, and conformance testing. The repository includes the formal specification, JSON schemas, and reference tooling. The specification documents are licensed CC BY 4.0; reference code in the repository is licensed AGPL 3.0.
